proof_policy: No paid-client cases assumed; label owned work and concepts honestly.
publication_policy: This plan does not create or publish a live site; release requires completed implementation and business facts.

release_gates.acceptance: Founder identity, owned domain/contact, honest online-only location, name review and rights records are real.
Every card, quote example and FAQ renders exact current scope and prices from offers.json; no hidden mandatory service.
Each work example is labeled owned/concept/paid and every claim and screenshot has evidence and rights.
Form receipt arrives in client-controlled destination, failures are understandable, no PII enters analytics.
320/360/390/768/desktop and zoom/reflow checks pass; direct navigation and 48px product targets work.
Manual keyboard, focus, labels/errors, contrast, text spacing and reduced-motion checks pass alongside automated checks.
Recorded mobile lab configuration and asset budgets pass; sufficient field p75 data is used later for CWV.
Canonical/status/robots/sitemap/title/internal link/schema and scoped redirect checks pass; no empty or gated pages linked.
Client-controlled source and accounts, least privilege, dependency/secret checks, reproduce build and tested rollback.
Exact content/version and payment milestones accepted before release; unresolved blockers are explicit.
Static ownership versus self-editing CMS fit stated before deposit; supported platform and actual third-party costs explicit.
Relevant dated capability proof, actual calendar and correction tail, cash floor, agreed client inputs and staffed response fit; no85h/week7 waiting rule.
Server validation/spam/rate/duplicate handling, recoverable submission record and actual inbox receipt. If Turnstile is used, verify its token server-side.
Per-client repo/project/environment, MFA/least privilege, secrets out of source/bundles/prompts/logs; minimal data, retention/deletion/export owner; staging access control plus indexing controls.
Name research is preliminary not trademark clearance. License/input and editable-source rights checked for selected tools and actual handoff; no fabricated identity/claims.

parallel_policy: Two active projects allowed when dated founder hours, review queue and launch recovery fit; measured prompt/AI gains may increase capacity.
motion_default: prerendered media with ordinary HTML/text and static/reduced-motion fallback; liveWebGL off unless separately justified and tested
